title: Publish V4 Guards 1.1.3 from the immutable 1.1.2 tag with only the PATH isolation fix
goal: Produce, certify, publish and install a 1.1.3 patch containing only the child-process PATH isolation repair plus required release metadata, without incorporating concurrent C1-C6 work or modifying prior releases.
acceptanceCriteria: The source diff is based directly on v4-guards-v1.1.2 and contains no C1-C6 candidate or inventory paths; the V4 behavior change is limited to build-evidence child PATH isolation.
Exact Formal Pre/Diff, Windows-full, offline Linux-complete, deterministic archive and candidate certification pass on one clean source commit with matching package hashes.
A new annotated tag and final GitHub Release expose only the verified 1.1.3 ZIP and SHA-256 sidecar, and a new verified sibling installation leaves all prior releases and PATH values unchanged.
